channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Offline No Spoil
item.description: Preserves perishable food in offline inventories and configured containers.

item.title: Realistic Biome Generation
item.description: ONE Equator. ONE North Pole. ONE South Pole. On ANY world size. Plus custom spawn latitude.

item.title: Cave-Only Ore Spawns
item.description: Ore spawns only in caves, on the cave walls, plus new modes for more efficent prospecting.

item.title: Rust Creatures Can Destroy Obstacles
item.description: By default, they break blocks only during temporal storms and in caves. Highly configurable.

item.title: Fablewood Harmony Patches
item.description: Harmony patches for compatibility.

item.title: Dense Ground Storage
item.description: Place down more items per block and on chiseled blocks

item.title: Boric Alchemy
item.description: Boric Alchemy adds chemical routes to create and refine resources, and create alchemical marvels!

item.title: Auto Map Markers (Client-Side Only)
item.description: Fork of Auto Map Markers — works with no server-side install required.

item.title: SheyderMod
item.description: A simple SheyderMod that supports the original artstyle of the game.

item.title: Clothes Have Pockets
item.description: Adds pockets (inventory slots) to various clothing items

item.title: Lupines
item.description: Adds playable anthro wolf like player model using Player Model Lib

item.title: Recipebook - Trait-locked recipes tab
item.description: Adds a Recipes tab to the survival handbook, listing every trait-locked recipe grouped by trait.

item.title: Waypoints NextGen
item.description: Adds +200 waypoint icons: food, ores, traders, craft buildings, conveyors, and more.

item.title: QP's Chisel Tools
item.description: Unleash your creativity while chiseling! Invaluable, survival friendly tool set for chiselers!

item.title: Sky's TerraTag SoundPack
item.description: Various sounds and music for TerraTag.

item.title: Free Immersive Craft
item.description: Craft single-ingredient recipes in-world… Ghost recipe overlay, cycling recipes, server-safe.

item.title: Vintage Canvas
item.description: Craft canvases, mix paint, and use brushes to decorate your world!

item.title: Temporally Stable Tweaks
item.description: Various tweaks for the Temporally Stable server.

item.title: Downed
item.description: Replaces the vanilla downed state with a survivable, invulnerable downed state. Quite bloody.

item.title: Feral Kinship: Companions
item.description: Turns tamed foxes into full companions with perks, moods, packs, expeditions, and more.

item.title: Immersive Clay Working
item.description: Adds break chance when firing clay items in the pitkiln and beehive kiln. Manage break risk by using

item.title: TreadWheel
item.description: No wind? No river? Walk inside the wheel and power your machines with your own legs.

item.title: Chisel Wiz - Powerful chisel shortcuts
item.description: Copy + paste chiselled blocks. Works on un-modded servers!

item.title: ChunkLOD
item.description: A Heavily Modified Fork of Farseer, representing terrain, rock type, forestation, and water as LOD's

item.title: Fish Breeding
item.description: A patch for my server that allows all fish to be bred with specific pellets for them

item.title: Shadehouse
item.description: Adds a way to build a 'shadehouse', to grow crops in hot temperatures.

item.title: Plumas Customizable Stack Sizes
item.description: Another Simple Stack Size mod because i was dissatisfied with the others

item.title: Grassroots Coca
item.description: Coca farming. Grow, dry, leech, refine, and recrystalize. Aim for the purest product.

item.title: Ecosystem - Flora
item.description: Making flora living

item.title: Solaria's Solace Server Tweaks
item.description: A bunch of fixes and additions for the server.
